name: Prompt Box
description: Standalone assistant composer with auto-resizing textarea, attachments row, model pill, slash-command hints, and send/stop states.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the trimmed prompt when the user presses Enter or Send. Example: onSubmit={(text) => run(text)}

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder of the auto-growing textarea. Example: placeholder="Describe the change"

props.name: model
props.description: Model badge shown in the footer. Example: model="gpt-5"

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the textarea and the send button. Example: disabled={busy}

props.name: busy
props.description: Turn the send button into Stop while a request is in flight. Example: busy={isStreaming}

props.name: attachments
props.description: Chips rendered above the textarea: id, name and optional size. Example: attachments={[{ id: "1", name: "spec.pdf" }]}

props.name: commands
props.description: Slash commands offered while the prompt starts with "/". Example: commands={[{ name: "review", description: "Review a diff" }]}

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when the user stops the running request. Example: onStop={abort}

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class names for the prompt card. Example: className="max-w-xl"
